sources.snippet: On August 21, 2026, the DeepSeek Official API Changelog announced the release of deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp. This experimental multimodal model is the final piece of the V4 puzzle, integrating sophisticated image and screenshot understanding into the ultra-fast V4-Flash architecture.

sources.title: DeepSeek V4 Flash Vision Exp: Vision API, Benchmarks & Cost - iweaver.ai
sources.snippet: DeepSeek released DeepSeek-V4-Flash-Vision-Exp, an experimental multimodal model available through its API. It accepts both text and images, bringing screenshot understanding, chart analysis, OCR-style tasks and other visual workflows into the V4 Flash family.

sources.title: DeepSeek v4 Flash Vision Exp is Released as Open Weights
sources.snippet: FlyCockpit/DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731-vision is a LoRA adapter + separate vision tower (deepencoder_v2_tower.safetensors) bolted onto 0731 — a different approach entirely, not the official Vision-Exp weights, and not something we'd want to build on.
